Preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. Cart has P-01 Natural-M, P-02 and P-05, all deselected.
Test Steps:
1. Select P-05 only and note the subtotal.
2. Tap Seller 1's store checkbox.
3. Deselect P-05.
4. Tap Check Out.
Expected Result: Subtotals: ₱399, then ₱1,098, then ₱699. Checkout contains only P-01 and P-02; P-05 stays in the cart.

Test Steps:

Test Scenario: Item goes out of stock or is deleted while in the cart
Preconditions: P-02 and P-05 in the cart, plus P-06.
Test Steps:
1. Seller 1 sets P-02 stock to 0. Seller 2 deletes P-05.
2. Open the cart and try to select P-02 and P-05.
3. Check out P-06.
Expected Result: P-02 and P-05 are marked unavailable and cannot be selected. P-06 checks out normally.

Preconditions: Logged in as Buyer 1. Cart has 2 items.
Test Steps:
1. Log out and back in.
2. Log in on a second phone.
Expected Result: The same 2 items and quantities appear in both phones.
